title: Creature
wikitext:
[[Image:flag_fi.gif]] Creature is an old-school CTF pro who played for the legendary clan [[Wuff]] for many years and then joined [[Hell]] in 2005 for [[NQR CTF Season 1|NQR CTF Season 1]]. When CTF took a long break beginning 2005, Creature regrouped to the TDM scene and became a legend.
